newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Bank rejects proposed merger.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Bank rejects proposed merger.

text.p: Directors of Peoples Bank unanimoulsy rejected a merger proposal from an unnamed company because the proposal "did not adequately recognize Peoples Bank's exciting future prospects," the commercial bank said on Tuesday.
In a letter to shareholders, directors said they had recently received a merger proposal from another company and that they had enlisted advisors in considering the proposal before rejecting it.
The letter also noted a recent trend of core earnings growth in rejecting the proposed deal and said the company will continue efforts to identify growth opportunities.
